name: io.github.Role1776/mcp-retrieval
title: MCP Retrieval
description: Local Go MCP server: DuckDuckGo/Bing web + image search, readability scraping to Markdown.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: stdio (client spawns the process) or http (streamable HTTP listener).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Server name reported in the MCP initialize handshake.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PATH
environmentVariables.description: HTTP path the MCP endpoint is served on. Used only when MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

environmentVariables.name: SERVER_PORT
environmentVariables.description: TCP port to listen on. Used only when MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

environmentVariables.name: SERVER_READ_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP read timeout as a Go duration. Used only when MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

environmentVariables.name: SERVER_WRITE_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP write timeout as a Go duration. Used only when MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_MODE
environmentVariables.description: local (text, debug) or prod (JSON, info). Logs go to stderr.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_IDLE_CONNS_PER_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Idle connections the outbound HTTP client keeps per host.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_QUERIES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum queries or URLs accepted in one call.

environmentVariables.name: DEFAULT_RESULTS
environmentVariables.description: Snippets returned per query when the call does not ask for a count.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_RESULTS
environmentVariables.description: Upper bound for snippets per query.

environmentVariables.name: DEFAULT_IMAGES
environmentVariables.description: Images returned per query when the call does not ask for a count.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_IMAGES
environmentVariables.description: Upper bound for images per query.

environmentVariables.name: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-call timeout in milliseconds when the call does not request one.

environmentVariables.name: MIN_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Lowest timeout a call may request, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Highest timeout a call may request, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: DEFAULT_DOCUMENT_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Characters kept per scraped page when the call does not ask for a limit.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_DOCUMENT_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Upper bound for characters kept per scraped page.

environmentVariables.name: PROXY_SCHEME
environmentVariables.description: Outbound proxy scheme. Optional; set all five PROXY_* variables or none.

environmentVariables.name: PROXY_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Outbound proxy host. Enables per-request rotating proxy sessions.

environmentVariables.name: PROXY_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Outbound proxy port. Required when PROXY_HOST is set.

environmentVariables.name: PROXY_LOGIN
environmentVariables.description: Outbound proxy username. Required when PROXY_HOST is set.

environmentVariables.name: PROXY_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Outbound proxy password. Required when PROXY_HOST is set.
